messages:
arjun_pm: Pushed a new mock for the billing landing—focus is the invoice CTA and ledger export: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi/usage-billing-invoice-v2 (see frame 'Landing - Invoice CTA'). Two options: 1) primary 'Download invoice' in the org banner, or 2) contextual CTAs on project cards that surface a 'Request invoice (org)' modal. Which is clearer?

marta_design: My take: keep a single prominent org-level Download button in the header (helps finance users). Project-level CTAs should be contextual links that explain they point to the org invoice. Avoid duplicate heavy CTAs.

tyler_eng: agree on single primary CTA. Implementation note: the download hits /billing/invoice?scope=org&month=XX and streams PDF. If we add project CTAs that open a modal we can pass ?project_id for context but still fetch org invoice. Minimal extra backend work.

kevin_billing: From billing ops: invoices are canonical at the org. Project CTAs should not promise independent invoices. Copy suggestion for project links: 'View org invoice for this project'. For the header button: 'Download org invoice'.

olga_a11y: a11y: ensure the header Download button has descriptive aria-label like "Download organization invoice for March 2026" when month selected. The project link should indicate it opens a modal and what happens next. Also keyboard users need focus order preserved (header first).

marta_design: will update copy. Also exploring a subtle affordance on project cards: three-dot menu -> 'View invoice context' to avoid clutter.

arjun_pm: Another ask: some customers want raw ledger CSV export (route-level) while others only want PDF invoice. Should we surface both?

tyler_eng: technically we can support both. CSV export will hit /billing/ledger?scope=org&format=csv and is heavier. Suggest making CSV an advanced option inside the invoice modal behind a confirmation because it can contain many rows.

kevin_billing: agree keep CSV in modal with a short warning: "May include sensitive route details." Also enforce RBAC: only billing roles see CSV link. Non-billing users get a read-only 'View invoice' that redacts payment details.

olga_a11y: modal accessibility: trap focus, provide a clear heading, and expose the CSV download as a native <a role="button" aria-describedby="csv-warning"> with role="button" and aria-describedby pointing to the warning text. Ensure the warning is programmatically associated.

marta_design: UI update: header now shows 'Total MTD charges' + small 'Download org invoice' CTA. Project cards show a kebab menu with 'Invoice context' (opens modal). Modal includes PDF download (primary) and CSV (secondary, requires role). I've updated the figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi/usage-billing-invoice-v2?node-id=120%3A4

arjun_pm: micro-copy proposals: header CTA -> 'Download org invoice (PDF)'; modal primary -> 'Download PDF invoice'; secondary -> 'Export ledger (CSV)'. Tooltip on project kebab: 'Links to org invoice for selected project'. Any objections?

kevin_billing: minor legal nit: replace 'invoice' with 'billing statement' in legal docs, but UI can stay 'Invoice' for product clarity. I'll sync with legal for consistent phrasing in exports.

tyler_eng: perf note: when rendering project grid for orgs with many projects, hide kebab menus until hover/focus to keep DOM light. Also debounce analytics pings for modal opens.

olga_a11y: ensure kebab menu is keyboard reachable and not hover-only. Visible focus styles required.

marta_design: will hide visually but keep it tabbable. Also adding a small SR-only text on each project card that reads 'Open actions for PROJECT_NAME'.

arjun_pm: one more ask: mobile layout — where does the Download org invoice CTA live on small screens?

marta_design: mobile: move Download button into the overflow header menu to save space; keep a persistent small 'Billing' FAB on project details screen. Will show a collapsed modal for downloads.

olga_a11y: mobile modal must be full-screen and include accessible close. Also ensure the FAB has an accessible label.

kevin_billing: final ops request: include invoice generation ETA and size estimate in the modal after user clicks download (e.g., "Preparing PDF • ~45s"). Helpful for large orgs.

tyler_eng: we'll stream progress events from the export job and show a progress indicator. Backend to return job_id and SSE/WS for progress.

arjun_pm: summary of action items: Marta: update copy + kebab SR text + mobile behavior; Tyler: spec for streaming invoice job + CSV endpoint warning; Kevin: confirm RBAC and legal phrasing; Olga: a11y checklist for modal and kebab; I'll schedule a short follow-up after updates.

ui-bot: Note: design-review slot reserved Thursday 11:30 UTC. Calendar invite sent. :spiral_calendar_pad:

arjun_pm: thanks all — please update the figma and leave comments on any places that increase vertical height. We want the landing to stay within 3 scroll lengths on desktop. Closing for now.
